rationale: Record that unlinking an unused GPU dylib from ad-hoc library-validated test fixtures crosses the visual-proof-harness selector without changing anything the family is about. The control trusted-host E2E fixture and the two sample-region control hosts were ad-hoc signed with --options library while transitively linking libwgpu_native.dylib. Ad-hoc signing carries no Team ID and library validation admits only platform-signed or same-Team libraries, so dyld refused the load and killed each binary at exec with 134. The process never answered the preflight challenge and the launcher reported preflight_rejected, so one dead child failed a cluster of control, inspector and daemon E2E tests. Because the link is decided at configure time from a machine-wide FetchContent cache rather than by any source change, it began failing on gate VMs while main stayed byte-identical. The fix drops the unused wgpu link and keeps the library-validation flag, which control_trusted_host_inventory requires and a test asserts. No detector, threshold, fixture, proof artifact or harness behaviour changes: otool -L shows the wgpu reference gone and the binaries execute instead of dying at load. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
